tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal ye shes mgon po'i thugs sgrub mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ma hā kā la sā dha naṃ nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal ldan khrag 'thung 'gro ba'i mgon// lha mo dang bcas 'khor lo la// btud de nag po chen po yi// sgrub pa'i rim pa bri bar bya// dbang gis smin byas dam tshig ldan// bla ma la gus snying brtser ldan// shes rab bzod ldan brtson 'grus che// sgrub la dpa' ba'i sngags pa yi// yid 'ong dben pa'i gnas dag gam// ri bo dur khrod ma mo dang*// gshin rje 'jigs su rung ba yi// gnas su nag po bsgrub par bya// maṇḍal mchod dang gtor ma bsham// rten bsham bde ba'i stan la 'dug /rang gi lha yi rnal 'byor du// zhugs te cho ga rdzogs pa dang*// bla ma la smod bstan la sdang*// de dag rab tu zhi ba'i phyir// bdag gis nag po bsgrub par bya'o// snyam du blo ni bskyed bya ste// skad cig gis ni stong par bya// mdun du padma nyi ma la// gnas pa'i yi ge hūm̐ nag po// bsams te de yi 'od zer gyis// gdug pa ma lus zhi byas te// 'gro kun bde ba la bzhag nas// slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim gyur te// yi ge gyur pas skad cig gis// bya rog gdong can nag po che// zhal gcig phyag bzhi g.yas pa na// dang po bhai ta'i 'bras bu dmar// gnyis pa ral gri 'dzin pa'o// g.yon gyi dang po rakta yis// rab tu gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin// gnyis pa kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin pa'o// stag gi pags pas smad dkris shing*// dbu skra ag tshom smin ma ser// spyan gsum mche gtsigs 'jigs par byed// thod pa rin chen sbrul gyis brgyan// sna tshogs padma nyi steng du// dpa' bo'i 'dug stangs kyis gnas pa'o// de nas rang gi snying ga yi// sa bon las 'phros 'od zer gyis// ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs la// mchod la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥyis// dgug gzhug bstim dang mnyes par bya// spyi bo mgrin pa snying ga ru// padma nyi ma'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ dang āḥdang oṃ gsum gyis// sku gsung thugs gsum byin gyis brlabs// legs par mchod de bstod nas ni// oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa// ces pa'i sngags ni ci nus par// man ngag bzhin du bzla bar bya// skyo na gtor ma byin brlabs te// rang sngags kyis ni bsngo bar bya// legs par mchod la de nyid kyi// rkang pa brgyad pas bstod par bya// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// las rnams gang yin de bcol bya// ye shes gshegs la dam tshig bsdu// blo ldan mtshan ma ma byung gi// bar du 'bad de bsgrub par bya// mtshan ma byung na bla ma yi// man ngag bzhin du las la sbyar// bla ma'i gsung gi rjes 'brangs te// bdag gis nag po sgrub pa'i thabs// bris pa'i bsod nams thob pa des// bgegs zhi mthu dbang thob par shog
/dpal nag po chen po'i sgrub thabs 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba tsa mi chen pos bsgyur ba'o//

sgrub thabs rgya mtshor yang yod/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la anta raṃ sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal mgon po'i nang sgrub ces bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po chen po sgrub 'dod rnal 'byor gyis// yid dang mthun pa'i dben gnas su// rten dang mchod pa rdzas bshams te// dang po byang chub sems bskyed la// mdun du skad cig 'dab brgyad der// dpal ldan nag po chen po la// lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba yang*// bya rgod mgo dang khyung gi mgo /khwa yi mgo dang 'ug pa'i mgo /de bzhi phyogs kyi lha mo'o// phag gi gdong dang khyi gdong ma// spyang ku stag gi gdong can bzhi// mtshams kyi lha mor shes par bya// kun kyang nag mo gri thod thogs// padma ro dang nyi steng na// zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs// de la bdun po rnam dag gis// mchod cing gsol ba btab byas la// rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsol// rang nyid yi dam gsal ba'i mdun// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ dang ram̐// padma nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐// 'phros 'dus gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan// 'od 'phros don byas slar 'dus nas// sa bon phyag mtshan gyur pa las// dpal ldan mgon po'i skur gyur te// zhal gcig spyan gsum smin ma 'khyug /khro gnyer zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil// phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis gri gug dang*// ral gri 'bar ba 'dzin pa dang*// g.yon pa'i phyag gnyis thod khrag dang*// mdung rtse gsum pa bsnams pa'o// zhabs gnyis phyed skyil 'gying bag can// stag lpags mgo phreng do shal byas// phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa la// klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan// lha mo brgyad dang gdong can gsum// de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed la// ye shes spyan drangs mchod cing bstod// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdagug gzhug bya// sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs// oṃ badzra ka'u ba ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

man ngag bzhin du bzla bar bya// skyo nas gtor ma 'bul byas la// mchod cing gsol gdab ye shes gshegs// dam tshig bsdus la dge ba bsngo// dge bas bar chad kun bsal nas// bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /mgon po bya rog gdong can gyi nang sgrub 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'o// paṇḍi ta a bha yā ka ra dang*/ lo tsā ba tsa mi chen pos sgyur ba'o// ༈ /dpal mgon po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la ya nā tha gu hya sā dha nā ma/ mar pa jo sras kyi 'grel pa yod pa gsal bar snang*/ bod skad du/ dpal mgon po chen po'i gsang ba'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ ye shes mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang zhag bdun zhal lta'i rgya gzhung khrag mtsho khol ma'i le'u zhe gcig pa las/ dang dam tshig ldan pa yis// gsang ba'i rnal 'byor bsgrub pa'i phyir// mchod dang gtor ma ldan pa yis// mgon po srog gi snying po bsgrub// sems bskyed ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// tshad med bsod nams tshogs gnyis bsags// stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng*// hūm̐ las 'od 'phros don byas te// 'dus pas nag po chen po ni// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum pa// gri gug ral gri thod khrag dang*// kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams drag po'i sku// rgyan cha rnam pa rdzogs par bskyed// yum ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug ma// mkha' 'gro brgyad kyis bskor ba yang*// shar du bya rgod gdong can ma// byang du khyung gi gdong can ma// nub tu khwa ta'i mgo can ma// lho ru 'ug pa'i mgo can ma// shar lhor phag gi mgo can ma// lho nub khyi yi mgo can ma// nub byang spyang ku'i mgo can ma// byang shar stag gi gdong can ma'o// zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'gying bag can// gcer bu dum bu'i rgyan gyis spras// bcu drug lo lon sgeg pa'i tshul// phyi nang gsang ba'i gnas tshul gyis// gar byed bde ba'i lha mo bskyed// gsang ba'i sngags ni 'di dag ste// oṃ badzra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ ka'u pa ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra gṛ ḍha syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gu ru ḍa syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ka ka syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ū lu ka syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bā rā ha syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shwa ne syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrīṃ ga la syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bya ghrā syai hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'od zer spro bsdus dbang du bsdu// phrin las bcol dus gtor ma 'bul// bskyed bstim byin rlabs dbang bskur la// rgyas gdab nyer bsdu'i rim pa'o// thun mtshams bskul pa dbye bsdu zhing*// yang dag ye shes snang bar rol// mi 'gyur mchog tu bsgrub pa'o// bde chen ngo bo'i gnas thob gyur// gsang sgrub thun mong ma yin pa slob dpon chen po spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa rdzogs so// dpal rgwa los bsgyur ba'o// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag rdor/ klu sgrub/ dril bu pa/ spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje/ a wa dhū tī/ byang chub bzang po/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi lo tsā/ dpal rgwa lo tsā/ phag mo gru pa/ 'jig rten gsum mgon sogs nas brgyud do// ༈ /ye shes mgon po sku regs ma'i rgya gzhung bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ tsitta gu hya sa ma ya mahā kṛṣṇa sā dha ni/ bod skad du/ nag po chen po gsang ba dam tshig gi thugs su sgrub pa'i thabs/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// nag po chen po gsang ba yi// sgrub la brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pas// chags pas dbang du bsdu ba dang*// drag po las la sbyar ba yi// gsang ba'i man ngag bstan 'di'o// sku gsung thugs dang phrin las dang*// yon tan sgrub pa 'di nyid de// srog dang srog ma yin pa dang*// dwangs ma dang ni snyigs ma la// thun mong khyad par shes par bya// gtor dang dril ba las kyi sngags// ye shes mgon po chen po yi// yab yum sbrel mar sgrub pa 'dis// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po srung*// las mgon gsum ni 'di yin te// tshe bdag sku dang 'chi bdag gsung*// srog bdag thugs te gsum yin no// las byed bdud dang rgyal po dang*// ma mo gsum du shes par bya// gsang ba'i yum ni khros ma che// dpung sgrol nag mo chen mo yin// 'di yi gsang sngags skyed tshul dag

/sbas pa drag mo zhes bya yin// gsang rten tsitta'i yang snying 'di// lus la bcang ba brten pa'i rdzas// dar nag bris sku srog snying bcas// lus dang grib ma bzhin du bsten// lha srin sde brgyad dbang du bsdus// bsad dang gso ba 'dir mi dgos// phyi nang gsang ba ma lus pa'i// sku gsung thugs ni 'di yin te// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod las// 'di ni yod pa tsam gyis ni// 'bod cing bsnyen pa sgrub pa dang*// rnal 'byor phrin las 'di yis 'grub// ces pa 'di dpal phag mo gru pa'i sku regs kyi ldeb nas dar dmar po sum yug gcig gis dril nas phyung ba yin no// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ shrī ma hā kā la syāṣṭa pā da sto tra nā ma/ bod skad du/ dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ grub par gyur cig hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces drag po'i sgra yis srid pa gsum gyi khongs ni ma lus 'gengs nus shing*// ha haṭṭā ṭṭā zhes bzhad gang zhig dus kun tu ni shin tu rab tu 'jigs mdzad pa// kam̐ kam̐ kam̐ zhes thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras shing nag po mchu dang mtshungs pa'i sku// bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ zhes nus pa mchog gi khro gnyer 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs sha za zhing*// dbu skra dang ni sma ra ches ser nye bar bskyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod// ram̐ ram̐ ram̐ zhes spyan dmar 'khrug cing sgyur mdzad krūm̐ krūm̐ krūm̐ zhes rab khros spyan gyis gzigs// smin ma ser zhing mche gtsigs ro yi gdan la dgyes pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong mdzod// hā hā hūm̐ dang ki li ki li zhes sgrogs phyag g.yon kha ṭwāṃ gar bcas thod pa bsnams// ru ru ru zhes khrag rgyun 'bab pa phyag gis bsnams shing gsol mdzad 'thung ba la dgyes shing*// kham̐ kham̐ kham̐ zhes gtum po'i phyag g.yas gri gug ral gris bgegs rnams la ni rol mdzad pa'i// ḍam̐ ḍam̐ ḍam̐ zhes ḍa ma ru can 'di yis 'dul mdzad 'khor bcas zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs// rab tu rngam zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas gshin rje dang mtshungs 'jigs pa'i sku brgyan cing*// kṣīṃ kṣīṃ kṣīṃ zhes bzod pa'i gzugs can ca co sgrogs par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung ste// gcig bus sna tshogs mnan cing mnan nas ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad char sprin sngon po'i mdog

/sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mas sbrel ba'i phreng bas kun nas brgyan cing zhal du gsol// drag shul phyag gis 'dod pa'i gzugs dang mi sdug gzugs can gyi ni 'byung po ro langs tshogs// ma lus bzung nas myur du bsad pa rnams kyi mgo bo khrag rgyun 'bab pa rab tu gsol// hraiṃ kṣ+yam̐ shrī yi sngags kyi gsung can pa tsa pa tsa'i sngags kyis bgegs rnams rab tu bsregs// rol pas rol pa rol zhing mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod// phaiṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ zhes sgrogs pas so sor bskyod pa'i me dpung chen po'i dbus su bzhugs nas su// rigs kyi lus can skyong bar mdzod cig sgrub po rnams kyi zhing rnams nges par zhing skyong mdzod// phyugs rnams kyi ni nyin re bzhin du bgegs dang sdig 'joms dri med brnyes pa chu nyi bzhin// tsam̐ tsam̐ tsam̐ zhes gtum po'i shugs kyis rab g.yos rmad byung sa yi 'jig rten snang mdzad pa// kram̐ kram̐ kram̐ zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par nyon mongs 'joms mdzad cing*// sam̐ sam̐ sam̐ zhes tshogs pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig thos 'dzin zhing skyong gang yin khyod kyis skyongs// pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ zhes gshin rje ltar khro dri ma med pa'i sna tshogs chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// yam̐ yam̐ yam̐ zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mkhyen// klām̐ klām̐ klām̐ zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyis srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang*// kṣām̐ kṣām̐ kṣām̐ zhes phan par mdzad cing gnod pa skad cig gis sel zhing skyong khyod kyis skyongs// pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong ba// sngags bdag sngags kyi gzugs can thugs kyis sngags pa rnams la blo gros 'bras bu mtshungs med ster// zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa khyod kyis 'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring skyong du gsol// sgrub pa po'am slob dpon gang zhig dam tshig thos 'dzin gang zhing blo ldan gyur pa dag

/thun gsum du ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur ba dang*// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs 'byor pa 'dzin dang gzi brjid rgyas pa mtshungs med ster// sa steng dang ni mtho ris su yang de yi bgegs kyi tshogs ni rtag tu nyams par 'gyur// dpal nag po chen po'i bstod pa rkang pa brgyad pa zhes bya ba slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// rgya gar kyi mkhan po ko sa la'i rnal 'byor pa bai ro tsa na badzra dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba btsun pa ding ri chos grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// ༈ /klu sgrub lugs kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor chog bzhugs so// na mo ratna wardhā ya/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin// 'khor lo sdom pa la btud de// grub pa'i nag po chen po yi// bsnyen pa'i cho ga bshad kyis nyon// dben pa'i gnas su mchod gtor bshams la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar pam̐ las padma dang a las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas grub pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan drang*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ yig las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pas mchod/ spro na/ gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod dang sdig pa bshags// gsum la skyabs 'gro byang chub sems mchog bskyed// mya ngan mi 'da' chos 'khor bskor bar gsol// dge la yi rang byang chub chen por bsngo// zhes lan gsum brjod de/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ shū n+ya tā'i sngags brjod de/ 'khor 'das gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong par gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings su pam̐ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba dang mi ro ser po'i steng du hūm̐ las ral gri chang zung gi dbus su zla ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ grub pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis kyis ral gri dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ dpa' bo'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing 'od zer drag po 'phro ba'o// spro na/ de'i dpral bar padma la gnas pa'i oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba la gnas pa'i āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po bsgom/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'og min chen po nas grub pa'i dpal rdo rje nag po chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ yum bzhis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ rang gi thugs ka nas sprul pa'i spyan ma la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsams la gong ltar mchod/ bstod pa gang shes kyis bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/

rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/ bdud rtsi thab sbyor gyi sngags ring gi mthar/ na maḥs manta kā ya wāka tsitta badzrā ṇāṃ oṃ ā ཿhūm̐/ oṃ mam̐ mam̐ ham̐ ham̐ kam̐ kam̐ ram̐ ram̐ ra ra ma hā kā lā ya piṅga lordha ke sha bandhe i maṃ ba liṃ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa pa ya gṛhṇa pa ya i daṃ karma ku ru/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bighnān bi nā ya kān/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs gsum mam lnga la sogs pas phul/ gong ltar mchod/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la pañtsa a mṛ ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul la 'dod don gsol/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i rkang pa brgyad pas bstod/ de tsam mi nus na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje nag po che// zhing rnams skyong mdzad khyod la bstod// bde skyong ma sha 'bras chan dang*// nya dang sha dang khrag dang chang*// nyer spyod bdud rtsi lngas bkang ste// grub pa'i nag po che la 'bul// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// bdag cag 'khor bcas bskyang ba dang*// skye 'gro bde zhing skyid pa sogs// 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes bstod cing phrin las zhus la/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng ba bsams te/ de'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus gang 'dod pa'i phrin las bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥmam̐ ham̐ ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa dang*/ spro na/ oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang shā sa na rnams ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mthar mchod bstod/ 'dod don zhus nas/ gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te sku la thim par bsams la/ gnas gsum bsrung ste dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis bya ba ni gzhung gis dngos bstan bdag bskyed ltar bsgrub pa'o// mdun bskyed ltar bsgrubs nas bris sku la sogs pa'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/

thog mar gtor ma byin brlab/ nam mkha'i dbyings su gtor mgron bskyed pa sogs gzhan rnams gong bzhin byas la/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis mgo drangs pa'i bzlas pa bya/ bzlas pa'i mchod bstod/ 'dod don sogs byas la/ mthar yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gnas gsum bsrungs la badzra muḥ mtheb srin gyi se gol gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// 'di ni 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi// gzhung gi dgongs pa ji bzhin tu// btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis// dag cing gsal bar bkod pa ste// dge des grub pa'i nag po ches// rtag tu bu bzhin bsrung ba dang*// tshe dpal ye shes rab rgyas te// rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrub shog /'di'i rjes gnang bka' bsgo dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags/ a bha yā ka ra/ shu bhaṃ ka ra/ pū dzi ti/ ratna rakṣi ta/ karti paṇḍi ta/ yar lung pa grags rgyal/ bla ma rgyal mtshan rin chen/ gar thig pa bsod rgyal/ bka' bcu pa gzhon seng*/ bla ma mgon po 'bum/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ chos rje shar pa/ rje rdo rje 'chang*/ 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ des bdag dkon mchog lhun grub la'o// rjes gnang gi chings sgrub thabs rgya mtsho bzhin mdzad pa'o// ༈ /phyag bzhi pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga bzhugs/ na maḥshrī tsa turbhu dzā ya/ 'di'i rjes gnang la/ bris sku'i mdun nam/ lha grangs kyi tshom bu'i mthar mchod gtor sogs 'og tu dgos pa rnams bsham/ bdag bskyed bde mchog bsgom/

mdun bskyed bris sku dang dbyer med dam/ tshom bu lhar bskyed/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs bya/ gtor ma rnams yi dam chos skyong so so la phul/ slob mas khrus byas la maṇḍal phul/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// thugs las sprul pa'i ye shes sku// bstan srung mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// byin rlabs rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ gur gyi rgyun bshags/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer dang*/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ slob ma rnams gtor chog ltar chos skyong 'khor bcas su bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed dang 'og min sogs nas mgon po dang*/ bsil ba'i tshal dang dur khrod brgyad nas las mgon rnams spyan drangs la bstim/ sngags rnams dang*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim/ sde tshan re re la sngags dang rol mo bya/ gu gul bsreg me long la sku bstan la mgon po'i sku snang la rang bzhin med par sgoms shig ces dang*/ sngags rnams kyi bzlas lung bya/ phyag mtshan bai ta byin la/ dpal ldan khyod kyis gdul bya la// tshe dang bsod nams yon tan 'phel// phan dang bde ba sgrub byed pa'i// rgyas pa'i phrin las bsgrub par gyis// oṃ badzra ka wu wa ma hā kā lā ya na ri ke la a bhi ṣiñtsa mi hūm̐/ thod pa byin la/ 'di ni dngos grub kun gyi gnas// thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dis// sna tshogs dbang du sdud pa yi// dbang gi phrin las bsgrub par gyis// sngags gong 'og 'dra ba la/ ka pā la ni a mṛ ta zhes dang*/ ral gri byin la/ 'di ni g.yul las rgyal byed cing*// bdud las rnam par rgyal byed pa'i// gcod byed ral gri 'bar ba 'dis// drag po'i phrin las bsgrub par gyis// khaḍga zhes dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga byin la/ lus ngag yid gsum nyes pa rnams// tshar gcod rtse gsum 'bar ba yis// ye shes sku gsum rtogs 'gyur bas// rnam rtog zhi bas sgrol bar mdzod// tri shū la badzra zhes sogs brjod/

gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la mgon por bsam/ de las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste/ dpral mgrin snying lte rkang mthil yan chad rim gyis gang bas lus ngag yid yon tan bya byed rnams/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi mgon po so so'i kha dog can du gyur par bsams la/ sngags rnams brjod/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas smos la bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig ces sogs brjod/ de rnams kyis ye shes mgon po 'khor bcas kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab pa/ rjes gnang lnga bka' bsgo'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par thob pas chos skyong 'di la dad cing gus pa dang*/ spyi dang khyad par gyi dam tshig bsrung snyam pa'i 'dun pas/ gtso bos sogs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ slob dpon gyis rten la brtan bzhugs bya/ maṇḍal yin na dngos grub blangs la gshegs su gsol/ bkra shis dga' ston bya'o// dpal sa skya lo tsā ba'i bka' drin las btsun pa ratna ni rā bho gas thob bo// 'di la cung zad rgyas pa zhig kyang yod do// 'di'i rjes gnang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal chen rga lo/ phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyid shod pa grags pa seng ge/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇa chen grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ des bdag la'o// yang na lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī nas/ sprul sku nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun nam mkha' rtse mo/ paṇa chen man 'dra'o// ༈ /ye shes mgon po'i sgo nas 'chi med sgrub pa'i gdams pa bzhugs/ na mo dzñā na nā thā ya/ skyabs sems ci nus bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/

swa bhā ba sogs stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du/ rang ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis gri thod/ g.yas 'og mas rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon 'og mas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ rin po che dang dar gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'dzag pa'i sku can du bsgoms la/ sku snang la rang bzhin med pa la yun ring du sems gtad/ oṃ a mā ra dza swā hā/ zhes stong la sogs pa bzlas/ mthar rlung bum pa can ci nus bzung la dge ba bsngo'o// sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje las// btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis// ji ltar thos bzhin bris pa ste// dge bas rdo rje'i sku thob shog/ ༈ /mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gtor chog bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha sidhā ya/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi pa'i gtor chog gi ngag 'don la sbyor ba ni/ rjes gnang gi yi ger bshad pa bzhin bya'o// dngos gzhi ni/ bde mchog lo nag sogs kyi bdag bskyed dang*/ gtor ma byin rlabs sogs bdag bskyed gang byas ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar padma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba/ gur/ bla re ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i nang du lha snam sngon po'i dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag de'i dbus su padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las ral gri yu bar hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' khro bo dang khro mo chos skyong thams cad kyi stobs dang nus mthu thams cad tshur 'dus hūm̐ yig ral gri dang bcas pa la thim/

de yongs su gyur pa las dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i lhun po ltar brjid cing nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od 'phro ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing bgrad pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas be ta'i 'bras bu dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas kha ṭwāṃ ga rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ dar nag gi stod g.yogs dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis dpa' bo'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i steng gi cha la g.yas su gnod sbyin gang po dang*/ g.yon du mdzes ldan sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis kyis bum pa lha'i bdud rtsis gang zhing yid bzhin gyi nor bus kha brgyan pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'o// gzhan yang mkha' lding*/ bya nag mi nag ce spyang la sogs pas bskor ba'o// de'i g.yon zur du padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du bhyoḥlas tsaṇḍi ka sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ spyan gsum dmar la bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang rtse gsum/ g.yon gnyis na mda' gzhu dang dgra mgo 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ g.yang gzhi'i stod g.yogs dang*/ gzig lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskums shing g.yon brkyangs pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ chos 'byung gi nang gi zur gsum du padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du g.yas zur du hūm̐ dang ral gri las sku'i sprul pa seng ge'i gdong pa can rab tu 'jigs shing g.yas ral gri g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/

g.yon zur du dzam̐ dang gri gug las gsung gi sprul pa ce spyang gi gdong pa can mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon 'dra/ gdong zur du kam̐ dang gri gug las thugs kyi sprul pa bya rog gi gdong pa can kha gdangs pa/ g.yas sogs 'dra'o// gsum ka yang thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ drag cing rngams pas g.yon brkyangs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la padma nyi ma mi ro'i steng du hūm̐ brgyad las shar du bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi= nub tu khwa ta'i= lhor 'ug pa'i= mer phag gi= bden bral du khyi'i= rlung du ce spyang gi= dbang ldan du stag gi gdong pa can te thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ drag mo shin tu khros pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ chos 'byung phyi ma'i zur gsum du padma nyi ma'i steng du gdong zur du bhe las gnod sbyin bya rog gdong can g.yas rin po che dang g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa seng ge sngon po'i steng na bzhugs pa/ g.yas zur du ya las srog bdag bya rog gdong can g.yas dus kyi dbyug pa dang g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa/ ma he smug po'i= g.yon zur keṃ las bdud po bya rog gdong can g.yas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ g.yon rwa'i mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ stod mi la smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa lus thams cad mig gis spras pa/ gsum ka'ang drag cing rngams la gtum pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ stag lpags kyis smad dkris pa'o// chos 'byung phyi ma'i kha khyer la rgyal chen bzhi la sogs pa gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang*/

phyi'i 'khor yug la mgon po beng 'dzin/ las mgon sde lnga/ e ka dzā ṭi sngags srung nag mo la sogs pa thams cad kyang mi sdug pa'i cha lugs can mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ dur khrod brgyad du nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum la sogs pas yongs su gang ba thams cad kyang drag po'i cha lugs can/ me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang*/ rdo rje gdan/ nā lend+ra/ bsil ba'i tshal nas ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ sngon tshe shākya seng ge'i spyan snga ru// mgon po khyod kyis ji ltar dam bcas bzhin// zhi rgyas dbang drag las la spyan 'dren na// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol// oṃ ma hā kā la tsa tur hasta sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi/ zhes pas spyan drangs nas/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ oṃ ma hā kā la nas wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lhas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang 'khor rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa re res dbu brgyan par bsam/ thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ka'u wa ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥmam̐ ham̐ ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta/

kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ shā sa na lan gsum dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ya de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li hūm̐ bhyoḥdzaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba sogs nas 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rdor dril 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ rgya gar dbus kyi rdo rje gdan// 'gyur med rgyun tu rtag pa'i gnas// dus gsum sangs rgyas byon pa'i yul// rdo rje gdan gyi shar phyogs na// gtsug lag khang chen nā lend+ra'i// chos skyong srung mar mnga' gsol ba'i// ye shes mgon po bya rog mtshan// khrag 'thung rgyal ba'i sprul pa ste// bstan pa bsrung phyir 'jigs pa'i gzugs// nag po chen po mthu stobs can// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor gyis bskor// khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdus// dgra bgegs ma lus rdul du rlog /bdud dgra 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// lha mo la/ bhyoḥ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong*// 'dab ldan rta bdun dbugs bral steng*// bhyoḥlas byung ba'i tsaṇḍi ka /dmar nag khros pa'i bzhin can bstod// g.yas gnyis mda' gri rtse gsum 'phyar// g.yon gnyis mda' gzhu dgra mgo 'dzin// mi sdug rgyan dang rol stabs can// hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrogs drag mor bstod// chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul can// khro dang 'khrugs dang rngams pa yi// bgegs 'joms lha mo khyod la bstod// ces bstod do// gtor ma gsum pa ni gdong can rnams kyis gsol bar bsams nas/ oṃ ma hā kā li kā ka syai hūm̐ phaṭa ces thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ bar gyi siṃ ha syai/ dzambha ka syai/ ka ka syai/ ghri ḍha syai/ ga ru ḍa syai/ kraṇḍa ka ka syai/ ū lu ka syai/ su ka ra syai/ shwa na syai/ shriṃ gā la syai/ byā ghra syai hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sham du ba liṃ ta btags pa gsum gyis phul/

oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bya rog gdong can la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa sogs 'dra'o// bstod pa ni/ gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i zhes sogs kyis bstod do// gtor ma bzhi pa ni/ kha khyer ba sogs la phul te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo sogs kyis phul/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa rnams kyi zhal du sogs brjod/ bka' nyan pho nya'i dbang 'dzin dang*// gdong can gsum dang gtsang ris kyi// dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sogs// sprul pa 'khor dang bcas la bstod// phyi rol gnas pa'i dur khrod du// nag po'i gzugs can sha za dang*// ma mo gnod sbyin la sogs pa'i// las byed bka' nyan 'khor bcas bstod// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan che// phrin las mgon po 'khor bcas la// bdag gis gtor ma phul ba yis// dkon mchog dbu 'phang dmod byed dang*// theg pa chen po sun 'byin dang*// bla ma'i sku la bsdo ba dang*// rnal 'byor bdag la gang sdang rnams// nag po chen pos sgrol bar mdzod// ces brjod cing phrin las bcol/ gtor ma lnga pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor nyid do// yi dam sogs kyi sngags bzlas pa dang*/ phyag mtshan la dmigs nas sngags cung zad bzla'o// de nas rjes gnang sogs kho bos byas pa'i yi ge bzhin bya'o// 'di ni rang gi brjed thor bris pa'o// ༈ /mgon po phyag bzhi pa lha mang gi rjes gnang bya tshul bklags pas don grub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha sidhā ya/ dpal ldan 'khor lo bde mchog gi// thugs las sprul pa'i ye shes pa// mgon po phyag bzhi 'khor bcas kyi// rjes gnang tshe 'phel bdag gis bshad// 'dir ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba la gsum las/ dang po sbyor ba ni/ gnas dben zhing nyams dga' bar stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du 'di'i bris sku sogs dgram/

maṇḍal la chos 'byung gru gsum/ de'i phyi rol du padma 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyi rol du chos 'byung gru gsum/ de'i phyi rol du lha snam zlum po/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad/ rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri bris te chos 'byung gnyis kha dog sngon po/ khyams dmar po/ padma sna tshogs/ lha snam sngon po/ dur khrod dang rdo rwa me ri rnams spyi dang mthun no// dbus su nyi ma la gtso bo'i dang*/ de'i g.yon du yum dang*/ zur gsum du pad nyi dang*/ pad 'dab brgyad rnams la tshom bu sngon po re re/ chos 'byung phyi'i zur gsum du las mgon so so'i tshom bu/ lha snam la tshom bu sngon po shas che ba mang du bkod do// de'i mthar mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog chu gnyis nyer spyod dang bcas pa/ de'i mdun na phar phyag mtshan tsa ka li/ de'i mdun du byang shar nas shar lho'i bar yi dam gyis gtor ma zlum po/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa ni gtor ma sum cha zlum po/ sum gnyis gru gsum mi rno ba be ta'i rnam pa lta bu/ bzhi pa dang lnga pa snga ma dang 'dra ba la mar rgyan ci mdzes dang*/ gtor dar dang*/ yod na mgon po'i tsa ka li btsugs/ gzhan yang sha la sogs pa dang*/ bum pa gzungs rdor/ rdo dril/ dung*/ me tog gi snod/ ḍa ma ru/ rnga/ nang mchod/ cha lang la sogs pa'i mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ mchod pa rnams sum bhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ bde mchog lo nag dril gsum gang rung gi bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya'o// bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/

nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma dang*/ 'jigs byed dus mtshan dang bcas pa'i steng du hūm̐ dang bam̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug las bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog sogs lo nag gang rung du bskyed/ pheṃ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ pheṃ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lhas ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa dang rnam snang gis dbu brgyan/ oṃ shrī tsakra saṃ wa ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda rol chen dang*/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ chos dbyings rnam dag sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te byung ba bum pa'i lha la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ shrī badzra he he sogs yab yum gyi sngags ci nus bzla/ mchod bstod/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ mchod g.yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ mdun bskyed bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje zhes sogs nas re res dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar gtor chog ltar bya'o// mchod pa/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda rol chen dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs nas khyod la bstod/ gtor ma bde mchog gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs nas yi dam la 'bul/ gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa dang lnga pa rnams gtor ma byin rlabs dran par byas nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ste/

oṃ ma hā kā la sogs nas kun 'grub shog gi bar dang*/ yi dam gyi sngags sogs bzla ba dang*/ phyag mtshan rnams la dmigs te bzlas pa cung zad bya'o zhes pa'i bar gu ge paṇa chen gyis mdzad pa'i gtor chog bzhin bya'o// slob ma bde mchog gi dbang thob pa bdun nam nyer lnga sogs khrus byas nas gral la 'khod pa la/ me tog bkye bsdu legs par grub nas slob dpon gyis/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba dang gnas skabs su 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i ched du ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la yang 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba mang*// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos byed pa'i gang zag ches dkon zhing*/ re re tsam byung ba la yang phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe'am bar chad shin tu mang bas/ de'i nyer 'tshe'am bar chad sel bar byed pa la srung ma re bsten dgos te/ de yang 'jig rten pa'i srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma gnyis las/ de la 'jig rten pa'i srung ma ni pho lha dang mo lha la sogs pa bsten kyang tshe 'dir 'phral gyi zas nor dang*/ 'khor g.yog 'du ba la sogs pa mthun rkyen cung zad sgrub nus kyang*/ mthar rang nyid la gnod cing nyer 'tshe byed pa yin no// gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma la yang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i rigs kyi srung ma'am chos skyong ni/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos gsungs pa'i tshe/

rang rang gi srog gi snying po phul nas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga la sogs pa ste/ de rnams bsten pas don 'grub par bshad kyang*/ de las khyad par du 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa nas gsungs pa'i chos skyong re bsten dgos pa yin/ de la yang rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa'i chos skyong srung ma'i rigs du ma yod pa las/ 'dir ma rgyud srung ba'i chos skyong bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa'i nang nas/ mgon po mngon 'byung gi rgyud kyi dngos bstan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang gdan bzhi la sogs pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa/ 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi chos skyong*/ dus zhabs pa la sogs pa'i bka' srung yin zhing*/ bsten na 'phral gyi zas nor dang tshe ring ba la sogs pa 'grub cing*/ mthar thug phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ster nus pa yin pas nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba'i ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la/ gang gis sgrub par byed pa'i slob dpon ni/ yi dam gyi bsnyen pa sogs sngon du song ba zhig dgos pa yin la/ gang la bya ba'i slob ma ni bde mchog la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa zhig la bya bar bshad pa yin lags/ nam bya ba'i dus ni yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bco lnga la sogs pa'i dus khyad par can la bya dgos pa yin la/ gang du bya ba'i gnas ni/ sa phyogs chos ldan gyi rgyal pos skyong zhing phyi nang gi nyer 'tshe med pa zhig tu bya bar bshad pa yin lags/ tshul ji ltar bya ba'i cho ga la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma la bya ba la rjes su gnang ba'i sngon 'gro/ slob dpon la 'khor lo bde mchog dngos yin snyam pa'i sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/

maṇḍal phul nas phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun gyi nas stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa la dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos nas/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlas lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces rgyud dag par bya ba ni sngon 'gro yin lags/ dngos gzhi la rjes gnang dngos zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bla ma dang yi dam sogs nas mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la 'khor lo bde mchog dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer bskal pa'i me lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus la reg pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang khyad par du rnam smin gyi phung khams skye mched/ nad gdon dgra bgegs bar du gcod pa thams cad bya sgro mes bsregs pa ltar gzhob thul gyis bsregs te lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur par mos/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis dmigs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas haṃ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sangs kyis sbyangs par mos/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje sogs nas/

thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la 'khor lo bde mchog dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pa'i rkyen gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ 'og min/ rdo rje gdan/ na lend+ra/ mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi mgon po'i sku che ba ri rab tsam chung ba rdul phran tsam dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug ba spu'i bu ga na mar thim par mos/ slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas bsil ba'i tshal/ dur khrod brgyad/ mdun bskyed dang bcas pa rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas las kyi mgon po dpag tu med par spyan drangs te/ las mgon so so la gnyis su med par thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sogs dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la sogs brjod cing rol mo/ gu gul gyi bdug des sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ khyed rang gi lus ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku'i ngo bor gyur pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer zhes pa nas/ mdun bskyed dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas gsung gi ngo bo rtsa sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ nye snying rnams rang rang gi yi ge 'brug gi sgra ltar sgrogs pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim par mos/ slob dpon sogs nas las mgon rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas srog snying dpag tu med pa byung ste khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi smad la thim par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī he ru sogs gong ltar brjod/ des gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob/ ngag gi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/

khyed rang gi ngag ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ slar yang dmigs pa sogs nas/ thugs ka nas phyag mtshan gyi ngo bo be ta'i 'bras bu dang thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ rdo rje sngon po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab par spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ shrī badzra he sogs sngar ltar brjod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ sems kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems kyi ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa yin snyam du mos/ de ltar sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs pa de nyid spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste tiṣṭha badzra zhes brtan par mos pa mdzod/ pheṃ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ de nyid la slob dpon gyis mchod par mos te/ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nas shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes mchod nas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang lha dang slob dpon gyis bkra shis kyis mnga' gsol bar mos nas/ me tog gtor te rdo dril 'dzin pas/ bkra shis gang zhig chos kyi sogs nas shlo ka dang po brjod nas/ bkra shis kyi tshig sngon du 'gro bas slob dpon dbang lha dang bcas pas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba re khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas mi bskyod pa re res dbu brgyan par mos/ de nyid la khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par byas par mos/ oṃ su pra sogs dang*/ me tog spyi bor bzhag ste/ de rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa yin/ rjes gnang dngos la/ sku bsgom pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ me long nang du bris sku'am/

tsa ka li 'char bar byas te slob mar bltar bcug la/ phyin chad khyed rnams kyis bris sku lta bu'am/ lder bzo lta bu ma yin par/ sku gsal la dwangs shing rdzogs pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu ngo bo bde stong gi bdag nyid du bsgom par gyis shig pa'i don yin/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng byung*/ zhal nas 'thon khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos nas me tog dang bcas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ oṃ badzra ka'u wa ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsum/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la shā sa na sogs lan gsum/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī sogs gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed kyi las mkhan rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas sngags phreng srog snying rnams kyang byung ste/ khyed rang rnams ye shes kyi mgon por gsal ba la phul bar mos nas sngags 'di rnams kyis rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ma hā kā li sogs nas syai hūm̐ phaṭa rnams brjod/ de ltar bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par mos nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i yid kyis slob dpon la drin lan gyi me tog gtor te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// slob dpon gyis/ khyed rnams kyis me tog gi phreng ba phul ba de sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te/ spyi bor me tog bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la ye shes kyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa rgyud la 'jug par gyur cig

thugs phyag mtshan gyi rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar phan bde bsgrub pa'i phyir du khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas su be ta'i 'bras bu gtad de rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ dpal ldan khyod kyis gdul bya la// tshe dang bsod nams yon tan 'phel// phan dang bde ba sgrub byed pa'i// rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrub par gyis// oṃ badzra ka'u wa ma hā kā la na ri ke la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dang*/ sna tshogs dbang du sdud pa'i phyir du phyag g.yon par thod pa gtad de/ 'di ni dngos grub kun gyi gnas// thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dis// sna tshogs dbang du sdud pa yin// dbang gi= /sngags mgo mjug 'dra ba las/ ka pā li ni a mṛ ta/ bdud las rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir du ral gri khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas su gtad de/ 'di ni g.yul las rgyal byed cing*// bdud las rnam par rgyal ba 'di// gcod byed ral gri 'bar ba yis// drag po'i= khaḍga/ sgo gsum gyi nyes pa tshar gcod par bya ba'i phyir du phyag g.yon par kha ṭwāṃ ga= lus ngag yid gsum nyes pa rnams// tshar gcod rtse gsum 'bar ba yis// ye shes sku gsum mngon gyur pas// rnam rtog zhi bas sgrol bar mdzod// tri shū la badzra/ yum gyi phyag mtshan la/ phung po'i bdud tshar gcod pa'i phyir du phyag g.yas par ral gri= mnyam nyid ye shes chen po la// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub// phung po'i bdud rnams 'joms byed pa// dga' ba chen po'i dbang bskur ro// 'chi bdag gi sogs nas phyag g.yon par rtse gsum= sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan che// tshe 'di nyid la sgrub byed cing*// 'chi bdag bdud rnams 'joms pa yi// mchog dga'= lha'i bu'i bdud sogs nas g.yon du mda' gzhu= 'di ni rang byung ye shes te// lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi dbyings// lha yi bu yi bdud 'joms pa// dga' bral= nyon mongs pa'i bdud sogs nas phyag g.yon du tshangs mgo=

dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku// bde stong gnyis med ye shes che// nyon mongs bdud rnams 'joms byed pa// lhan cig skyes dga'i dbang bskur ro// gdug pa can rnams bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir du phyag g.yas g.yon du gri gug dang thod pa byin te rjes su gnang ba byin par mos/ hūm̐/ las kyi mgon po 'khor bcas kyi// phyag mtshan gri thod 'bar ba 'dis// gdug pa can rnams bsgral ba dang*// nyams pa rnams kyi khrag rgyun 'thungs// sangs rgyas bstan pa ring du srungs// rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin sgrubs// kha dhi ka ka pā la= yon tan gtor mas byin gyis brlab cing bka' bsgo ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos skyong srung ma rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du mngon sum du bzhugs par mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma mgor bzhag ste mgon po'i sngags rnams brjod la/ gtor ma ye shes kyi mgon po'i rang bzhin las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste/ khyed rang gi mgo bo'i nang gang bas lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku ye shes kyi mgon po dkar po'i ngo bor gyur par mos/ mgrin pa'i nang gang bas ngag gi dri ma dag gsung ye shes kyi mgon po dmar po'i ngo bor gyur par mos/ snying ga'i nang gang bas yid gyi dri ma dag thugs ye shes kyi mgon po mthing ga'i ngo bor gyur par mos/ lte ba'i nang yan chad gang bas lus ngag yid gsum kyi dri ma dag yon tan ye shes kyi mgon po ser po'i ngo bor gyur par mos/ rkang mthil yan chad gang bas bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma mtha' dag dag phrin las ye shes kyi mgon po ljang gu'i ngo bor gyur par mos te/ dam la bzhag pa ni/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ ye shes kyi mgon po/

slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ārya de wa/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dus zhabs pa che chung*/ rtswa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal chen rgwa lo/ bde gshegs phag mo grub/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ skyid shod pa bkra shis 'bum/ skyid shod pa grags pa seng ge/ slob dpon sangs rgyas gzhon nu/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ paṇḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ gnyan lo grags pa blo gros/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge la sogs pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig 'di rnams kyi chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i= steng gdon gza' dang drang srong gi gnod pa= 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa= bar gdon btsan dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ the'u rang gi gnod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ gzhan yang gzugs med kyi gnod pa/ pha rol gyi rbod gtong*/ mnan gtad gzer gsum la sogs pa'i bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mthun pa'i rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas/ zas gos longs spyod kyis phongs pa med pa yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang*/ 'gro ba mang po la phan thogs pa'i= rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi dam pa'i chos sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang*/

sa dang lam gyi rtogs pa thams cad yar 'phel du gyur te/ mthar thug tshe 'di nyid la sangs rgyas thob pa'i grogs ldan dang 'phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cig ces pa ni gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba yin la/ phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod dang*// bskrad dang dbye dang dgug pa dang*// ril bu mig sman mchil lh+wam sogs// las rnams thams cad ci dgar sgrubs// khyed kyis bla ma'i sku dgra dang*// dkon mchog brnyas shing bstan pa bshig /sems can kun la 'tshe ba rnams// snying rje'i shugs kyis bsgral bar gyis// de las 'da' bar bya ba min// ces gsungs pa'i dam tshig rnams la srung sdom tshul bzhin du gyis shig pa'i don yin lags/ des dngos gzhi grub nas/ rjes mi 'bral bar bya ba la gnyis las/ dang po sgrub pa po chos skyong dang mi 'bral ba'i ched du khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdom tshul bzhin du byed pa dang*/ bye brag tu gsang sngags kyi chos zhus pa'i bla ma la gus par byed pa dang*/ khyad par du rdo rje nag po chen po 'di nyid kyi rjes su gnang ba dang gdams ngag zhus pa'i bla ma dang chos rgyud la dad cing gus pas/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul du 'khor ba chos nyid yin pas de ltar bya dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa chos skyong sgrub pa po dang mi 'bral ba ni/ 'di'i rjes gnang legs par thob tshun chad rab kyis thun bzhi'am/ gsum mam/ gnyis sam/ tha mas kyang thun gcig la sogs pa la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ de tsam ma grub na zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes brgyad gnyis dang yar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang*/ mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi sogs la gtor ma 'bul ba'am/ rang gis mi shes na gzhan 'bul du 'jug pa la brtson par bya dgos pa yin no// de ltar phul ba'i dgos pa ni rgyud las/ sems can rnams kyi srog bsrung phyir// rdo rje sems dpas gtor ma bstan// zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/

de bzhin du gsang bar gdams pa ni/ rgya mtsho'i nang gi rdo ba bzhin// kha ru dbyung bar mi bya'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ spyir gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i chos thams cad gsang nas nyams su len dgos pa la/ khyad par du rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa dang las sbyor dang rjes su gnang ba dang gdams pa la sogs pa ston pa'i tshe dbang ma thob pa dang*/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa'i gang zag rnams la gsang dgos pa yin no// gsang ba'i chos mi 'dod pa la ston pa ni yan lag gi ltung bar bshad pa yin no// 'o na rtsa ba nas gsang ba yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ man ngag gser gyi yang zhun ni// snod ldan zhig la nub mi bya// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ snod dang ldan pa'i slob ma re re tsam la ster na yang bka' rgya dang bcas pa'i sgo nas bstan dgos pa yin no// gzhan yang chos skyong gi 'khor du gtogs pa'i bya nag khyi nag sogs la rdo mi 'phen pa dang*/ mi nag dang a tsa ra dang*/ mon pa pho mo la sogs pa 'khor du bsten pa'am bsten mi nus na longs spyod kyis mnyes par bya ba la bslab dgos par bshad pa yin no// mdor na gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos dang*/ rjes gnang thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal 'bul bar zhu/ lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas sogs brjod/ de rnams kyis ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'khor bcas kyi rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas mchod gtor la brtson pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs dang*/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ oṃ shrī ma hā sogs nas bstod ces pa'i bar dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum/

ma 'byor pa sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs nas/ badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du oṃ ha/ na ma hi sogs go cha gsum dang*/ tsham rngam sngags kyis bsrung*/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang cung zad bsdus pa byed par 'dod na thams cad mkhyen pa bhaṭṭa ra ka ratna ni rā bho gas mdzad pa'i gsung rab las shes par bya'o// de ltar ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i// rjes gnang bya tshul bklags pas don grub 'di// sbyar ba'i dge bas bar chad zhi ba dang*// mthar thug 'khor lo bde mchog thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po gzhi sde chos rje dpal ldan phun tshogs pas chab gser gyi me tog dang*/ bka' lung nan chen pos rgyang ring mo nas bskul ba'i ngor/ rdo rje 'chang chen po buddha sidha'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa shākya'i bha danta ga ga na shrī bha dras e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ga chen kun dga' dpal legs so// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
